title: Health
subtitle: Read-only facts from recorded household data
context: Health describes what recorded Money, Plan, and Inbox facts currently show. It does not give advice or change money.
loadErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.

states.noVisibleFactsBody: Health can show coverage only after Money, Plan, or Inbox facts are recorded.
states.partialBody: {visible} of {total} source areas have recorded facts. Shown counts come only from those sources.

pulseMeaning: This pulse uses recorded account count, active plan jars, and Inbox load. It is not a credit rating, net-worth score, or financial advice.

narratives.starting: Recorded accounts, plan jars, and Inbox load currently show a starting pulse.
narratives.steady: Recorded accounts, plan jars, and Inbox load currently show a steady pulse.
narratives.strong: Recorded accounts, plan jars, and Inbox load currently show a strong pulse.

factorsDescription: Counts from existing household records. Missing sources stay missing.

factors.accounts: {count, plural, =0 {No recorded accounts} one {# recorded account} other {# recorded accounts}}
factors.jars: {count, plural, =0 {No active plan jars} one {# active plan jar} other {# active plan jars}}
factors.inbox: {count, plural, =0 {No open Inbox items} one {# open Inbox item} other {# open Inbox items}}

coverageMissingAccounts: No recorded accounts are visible in this view.
coverageMissingPlan: No active plan jars are visible in this view.
limitationsBody: Health uses recorded accounts, plan jars, Inbox items, and recent ledger activity. It does not see finances that are not recorded in ViNha.
emiCelebrateBody: An installment completion is waiting in Inbox. Health does not invent a new ledger balance.

insights.title: Insights
insights.subtitle: Read-only notices from recorded household facts
insights.context: These notices describe recorded counts. They are not recommendations, forecasts, or a second Money dashboard.
insights.loadErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.
insights.emptyTitle: No recorded facts to describe yet
insights.emptyDescription: When Money, Plan, or Inbox has recorded facts, notices appear here.
insights.scenarioReadOnly: These scenarios describe existing coverage inputs. They do not change money, plans, or decisions.

emi_complete.title: Installment complete
emi_complete.body: An EMI completion is waiting in Inbox. No new ledger balance is invented here.

setup.title: Setup coverage
setup.body: Recorded accounts: {accountCount}. Active jars: {jarCount}. Real position lives in Money; jars stay intention.

inbox.title: Open Inbox items
inbox.body: {count, plural, one {# open item is waiting in Inbox.} other {# open items are waiting in Inbox.}}

activity.title: Recent ledger activity
activity.body: {count, plural, =0 {No recent cleared moves are recorded yet.} one {# recent ledger move (real position only).} other {# recent ledger moves (real position only).}}

plan.title: Plan intention is recorded
plan.body: {count, plural, one {# Active jar is recorded as intention — not bank balance.} other {# Active jars are recorded as intention — not bank balance.}}

ai_guardrail.title: Facts stay grounded
ai_guardrail.body: Health may explain from household data only. It must not invent balances or move money.

clear_inbox.title: Inbox load as a pulse input
clear_inbox.body: This pulse treats Inbox load as one input. Open items: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}. Ledger totals are unchanged here.

add_jar.title: No active plan jar recorded
add_jar.body: No Active jar is recorded. Jars are intention. They never become unlabeled bank balance.

keep_rhythm.title: Pulse sources
keep_rhythm.body: This pulse stays visible from recorded setup and Inbox load, not invented cash.
